issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וּבְרוּחַ אַפֶּיךָ' means 'by the blast of your nostrils' (God's breath/nostrils), but the Vietnamese says 'Lời phán của Ngài thổi ra' ('the word of your speech blew out'), which changes the subject from God's breath/nostrils to His spoken word, altering the imagery and meaning.
